main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: slope t (clustered by day) >= 2 with supporting check passing confirms; t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: top-fifth minus bottom-fifth mean next-day excess return

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom-fifth excess return is above 0.
reading: Every bar with a forecast and a same-window next close enters (zero forecasts included); the slope's t uses an intercept and CR1 cluster-robust errors by UTC day; top/bottom fifths are forecast >= pooled 80th / <= pooled 20th percentile; 'days with recorded forecasts' are distinct UTC days with a non-missing forecast on any coin.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0001347 on the check folds against +0.0001937 on every fold
